Providing examples is also fine; by teaching it that verification is necessary and providing specific methods for that verification, it will proceed with the verification exactly as instructed.

title: 💻 Claude Code /batch vs claude -p: Parallel Changes or CI Automation - SmartScope
content:
Claude Code 技术干货

Choose `/batch` when applying bulk changes across an entire project. Choose headless mode when embedding AI processing into existing CI/CD pipelines.

## /batch Command: Parallel Execution of Large-Scale Code Changes¶

### Basic Usage¶

`/batch` is a bundled skill invoked with slash-command syntax inside an interactive Claude Code session.1 It researches the repository, proposes 5–30 independent units, waits for plan approval, and then creates one worktree-isolated background agent per unit.2 [...] Repeated multi-turn calls retain more context than a tightly scoped one-shot task. For independent file checks, short `claude -p` calls are easier to budget. For architecture review, preserving context can still be worth the additional usage.

Choosing the right approach for each use case is the key to balancing quality and cost.

## Summary¶

Claude Code's batch processing is built on two pillars: `/batch` and headless mode (`claude -p`). [...] Claude Code has two different ways to run work at scale. Use `/batch` to split one repository-wide change across independent worktrees and pull requests. Use `claude -p` when a script or CI job needs one non-interactive result.

title: 💻 How to Build Custom Claude Code Skills: Complete Tutorial — SKILL.md structure, advanced patterns, production best practices, and real-world examples (2026). · GitHub
content:
Claude Code 技术干货

Claude Code skills are reusable, project-specific instructions that transform your AI assistant from a generic tool into a specialized team member. Instead of repeating the same context and instructions every session, skills let you encode your team's knowledge, coding standards, and workflows into files that Claude Code loads automatically. [...] This tutorial covers everything you need to build, organize, and deploy custom skills — from basic SKILL.md structure to advanced patterns used in production.

## What Are Claude Code Skills?

A skill is a markdown file (typically `SKILL.md`) that contains structured instructions for Claude Code. When you reference a skill — either manually or through automation — Claude Code reads the file and follows its instructions for the current session.

`SKILL.md` [...] Description: One sentence. This helps Claude Code decide whether to activate the skill when multiple are available.

Trigger: Defines when the skill runs. Options include:

`manual`
`auto`
`on-commit`
`on-file-change`

Context: Background information that Claude Code doesn't have by default. Include architecture decisions, team preferences, and domain-specific knowledge.

Instructions: The step-by-step workflow. Be specific and sequential. Claude Code follows these literally.
